title: inferCSN 1.2.4
text: Replaced fit_srm() greedy-L0 interfaces fit_greedy_l0() fit_greedy_l0_batch(). Replaced legacy regularization, cross-validation, subsampling arguments inferCSN() pseudotime, max_support_size, lag_fraction, lag_steps. Added static pseudotime-ordered network inference dense sparse matrices, including multi-branch pseudotime deterministic parallel output. Added early-precision, signed-edge, motif, path, cross-run stability metrics. Extended plot_network_heatmap() aligned multi-network layouts, performance labels, ground-truth cell borders. Removed L0Learn added thisplot plotting support. Added R-hub platform checks manual CRAN release checks, updated checkout actions v5. Updated generated documentation, examples, example datasets, pkgdown reference index.
